python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as E
from PIL import Image,ImageOps,ImageDraw
print('DELIVERED',Path('inputs/delivered-baseline.json').read_text())
thumbs=[]
for s in json.loads(Path('inputs/samples.json').read_text()):
 p=Path('inputs/images')/(s+'.png'); im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); print('\nIMAGE',s,im.size)
 for mode in ['6','11']:
  r=subprocess.run(['tesseract',str(p),'stdout','--psm',mode],capture_output=True,text=True); print('OCR',mode,r.stdout[:2200])
 q=Path('inputs/baselines/audiveris-enlarged')/(s+'-raw.mxl')
 with zipfile.ZipFile(q) as z:
  name=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml') and not n.startswith('META-INF')); root=E.fromstring(z.read(name))
 for part in root.findall('part'):
  for mi,m in enumerate(part.findall('measure')):
   print('XML',mi,m.get('number'),'div',m.findtext('attributes/divisions'),'notes',[(n.findtext('pitch/step'),n.findtext('pitch/octave'),n.findtext('duration'),n.findtext('type'),n.findtext('voice'),n.find('chord') is not None) for n in m.findall('note')], 'harmony',[(h.findtext('root/root-step'),h.findtext('kind'),h.findtext('bass/bass-step'),h.findtext('offset')) for h in m.findall('harmony')])
 im.thumbnail((1500,420)); panel=Image.new('RGB',(1520,450),'white'); panel.paste(im,(10,25)); ImageDraw.Draw(panel).text((10,5),s,fill='black'); thumbs.append(panel)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1520,450*len(thumbs)),'white')
for i,p in enumerate(thumbs):canvas.paste(p,(0,450*i))
canvas.save('inspection.png')
PY
